title: AI data center construction demand holds firm despite labor shortages as Acter's order backlog reaches NT$84 billion
html:
Recent reports suggesting a slowdown in AI data center construction, alongside adjustments to investment and project schedules by some companies, have raised concerns that demand for AI infrastructure may be cooling.
